title: Add a small function to a spec
prompt: Add and export slugify(text) in util.js. It lowercases, trims, turns every run of non-alphanumeric characters into one dash, and leaves no leading or trailing dash. Example: 'Hello, World!' becomes 'hello-world'. Do not change test.js.

files.test.js:
const assert = require('assert')
const { slugify } = require('./util')
assert.strictEqual(slugify('Hello, World!'), 'hello-world')
assert.strictEqual(slugify('  A   b  '), 'a-b')
assert.strictEqual(slugify('--x--'), 'x')
assert.strictEqual(slugify(''), '')
assert.strictEqual(slugify('Ab1 2c'), 'ab1-2c')
console.log('ok')

check: node test.js && git diff --quiet HEAD -- test.js
